Specification: This module defines a small helper specification for emitting a TLC counterexample trace to a plain text TLA+ module file. It constructs a textual module containing a LOCAL INSTANCE TLC declaration and a Trace definition derived from CounterExample, then conditionally serializes that text to the file named by the constant _TLCTraceFile. The logic checks whether CounterExample.state is empty or whether console output is disabled in the CounterExample record, and otherwise requires successful serialization and prints a confirmation message; it is a utility module rather than a protocol or distributed algorithm specification.
IfThenElse: IF CounterExample.state = {} \/ ("console" \in DOMAIN CounterExample /\ CounterExample["console"] = FALSE) THEN TRUE ELSE /\ Serialize(_TLCTraceModule, _TLCTraceFile, [format |-> "TXT", charset |-> "UTF-8", openOptions |-> <<"WRITE", "CREATE", "TRUNCATE_EXISTING">>]).exitValue = 0 /\ PrintT("CounterExample written: " \o _TLCTraceFile)
